brief:
More than 100 settlers attacked residents of Qusra, a town south of Nablus, on Saturday following an attempt to reach a house under construction in the community, according to Shehab Wire. Municipal council member Ziyad Odeh reported that the settlers subsequently surrounded the dwelling.

The assault resulted in the detention of four youths during the confrontation. Details regarding the circumstances that prompted the settlers' initial attempt to access the construction site remained unclear from available reporting.
